_README: Fleet kit v10 CLI display keys (FLEET-COMMON item 15; UI/UX standard section 3). Applied by MAIN to BOTH account settings files; a tree's .claude/settings*.json sets NONE of the keys in tree_forbidden. `settings` keys are set at the top level, `env` keys merged into the account env, `unset` keys removed. In commands, {node} is the node executable and {kit} the directory holding this file, both rendered by MAIN's tools/fleet_kit.py with forward slashes.
